ASSESSMENT OVERVIEW: The lease is a 12-month term ending Dec 31, requiring written non-renewal notice 45 days prior (by Dec 10). Month 10 sales results (available Nov 3) provide sufficient time to calculate and deliver notice, avoiding automatic renewal penalties. The landlord's 'simple 1-year pop-up lease' description aligns with the clause's month-to-month conversion after Month 12, confirming no penalty risk if notice is timely. Key facts: Non-renewal notice deadline: 45 days before Dec 31 (by Dec 10); Month 10 sales results available November 3, providing 38 days to deliver notice; Lease converts to month-to-month after Month 12 without renewal penalty.
POINTS OF NOTE: No concrete constraint violations flagged.
SUGGESTED NEXT STEP: None required; stated constraints appear satisfied.
